messages:
Sana: Quick heads-up — bringing up a q4b-int4 candidate for longctx tests; we saw a small regression on code-summaries and suspect dedupe/provenance gaps in the multimodal anchorbank. Need a short curation sprint to refresh the golden set before canary.

Olivia: TL;DR of the failure and what you want from curation?

Sana: New quant kernel tweaks change tokenization of inline snippets and some caption normalization. That made our fingerprinting (text hash + image p-hash) miss ~3% duplicates; a few gold labels conflict with new outputs. Proposed flow: 1) run fuzzy dedupe on image+caption pairs, 2) cluster with perceptual p-hash, 3) surface top ~500 high-risk clusters for relabeling, 4) lock golden and run quick eval.

Jay: Where are the candidate rows? size?

Sana: s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/2026-03-20/candidates.parquet (~120k rows). We'll stratify sample by model-error-rate and cluster size.

Ben: I can kick off the fuzzy pass. Command I used last round: 
```
python tools/fuzzy_dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/2026-03-20/candidates.parquet --out s3://redwood-curation/anchorbank/q4b_candidates/dedupe_clusters.json --threshold 0.82
```
I'll run it tomorrow morning and attach cluster metadata.

Maya: I'll coordinate labelers for the relabel batch. Request: 3 annotators per item, majority consensus, and a short instruction checklist for multimodal edgecases (esp. decorative text and OCR noise). ETA for relabel job?

Maya: Also, can we include a few example thumbs-up / thumbs-down annotation examples in the instruction sheet? Last audit had inconsistent marking on decorative overlays.

Sana: Good call. I drafted an instruction page in Notion (internal): https://notion.so/rw/anchorbank-multimodal-handbook — will add examples. Use labeler queue id `ml_anchor_relabel_v2`.

LabellerBot: Created labeling job `ml_anchor_relabel_v2` with 520 items — due 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC. Assigned: Maya (owner), Liam, Arman.

Liam: I'll take ~200 items, will prioritize high-conflict clusters. Target to finish by 2026-03-23.

Arman: I'll add a QC pass for 50 gold anchors after relabel to validate consistency.

Sana: After relabel we'll run an eval sweep: sample 2k prompts across hosted/dedicated/q4b-candidate; compute anchor recall and hallucination delta. Promotion criteria: hallucination delta < 1.5% and recall within baseline ±1%. If we pass, we promote to a canary slot.

Olivia: Can someone link the quantization smoke-test runbook? If relabel shifts metrics we need a clear rollback plan.

Sana: I'll embed the smoke checklist in the Notion doc and ping infra for a canary window. Also adding the s3 paths and seed lists.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved on `dedicated-gpu-12` for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.

Sana: Next steps / owners:
- Ben: fuzzy dedupe cluster run and upload clusters (by 2026-03-21)
- Maya: finalize labeling instructions and spin up `ml_anchor_relabel_v2` (by 2026-03-21)
- Liam & Arman: complete labeling + QC (by 2026-03-24)
- Sana: run eval + decide canary promotion (2026-03-25)

Olivia: :eyes:

Ben: Starting fuzzy dedupe now, will post cluster summary when done.

Sana: Thanks team — will follow up in the Notion doc and drop a summary in #eng-ml when clusters and the label job are ready. :thumbsup:
